adds.title: South Carolina May 2024 gender-affirming healthcare ban - Legislature bill signed by Governor
adds.summary: In May 2024 South Carolina enacted a law signed by Gov. Henry McMaster prohibiting healthcare workers from prescribing puberty blockers or hormone treatments or performing gender-affirming surgeries for transgender people under age 18, with an exception permitting puberty blockers for cisgender conditions such as precocious puberty, thereby denying trans youth visitors legal access to gender-affirming medical care in the state.
